_meta.indication: ENSACOVE is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who have not previously received an ALK-inhibitor.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in reviewed documents for eXALT3
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized (1:1), open-label, global, active-controlled trial: ensartinib 225 mg orally once daily vs crizotinib 250 mg orally twice daily on 28-day cycles
pivotal_trials.population: Patients ≥18 years with locally advanced (stage IIIB) or metastatic ALK-positive NSCLC who received up to one prior chemotherapy regimen and no prior ALK TKI
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) per RECIST v1.1; key secondary endpoint was overall survival (OS)
pivotal_trials.result: PFS HR 0.56 (95% CI: 0.40, 0.79; p=0.0007); median PFS 25.8 months (ensartinib) vs 12.7 months (crizotinib). OS not statistically significant: median OS 63.2 vs 55.7 months, HR 0.88 (95% CI: 0.63, 1.23)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%) were rash, musculoskeletal pain, constipation, pruritus, cough, nausea, edema, vomiting, fatigue, and pyrexia. In eXALT3 serious adverse reactions occurred in 23% of patients; one fatal adverse reaction (0.7%) occurred due to bronchopneumonia; permanent discontinuation due to an adverse reaction occurred in 12%. Warnings include ILD/pneumonitis, hepatotoxicity, dermatologic reactions, bradycardia, hyperglycemia.
target_moa: Ensartinib is an oral inhibitor of anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK), ROS1, and MET kinases; ALK gene rearrangements (fusions) are oncogenic drivers in NSCLC
companion_dx_detail: Patient selection is based on presence of ALK rearrangement(s) in tumor specimens, but an FDA-approved test to detect ALK rearrangements for selecting patients for ENSACOVE is not currently available

advisory_committee.vote: An advisory committee was not held during this marketing application review because there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

citations.quote: September 9, 2020	Orphan drug designation was denied.

summary.text: This was a standard-review NDA that received traditional approval based on a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in PFS in the eXALT3 trial; no accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track, or priority review designations were applied and orphan drug designation was denied.

citations.quote: The submitted evidence meets the statutory evidentiary standard for traditional approval. The observed improvement in PFS in eXALT3 is statistically robust and clinically meaningful.
